body.x: Otiton-Medical Co., Ltd. (CEO Kim Jaeyoung) announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. Known for its innovative smart thermometers, the company has gained recognition in the healthcare industry for enabling at-home diagnosis of conditions like otitis media, sinusitis, and tonsillitis.

Otiton-Medical’s flagship product performs standard temperature measurements and includes an endoscopic camera capable of capturing ear, nose, and throat images to detect potential health issues. This innovation is at the core of its healthcare platform, Dr. In Home, which has already gained traction in markets such as the U.S., Japan, China, Australia, and Vietnam. The platform’s localized functionality, language support, and seamless integration with telemedicine systems have contributed to its growing global reputation.
At CES 2025, Otiton-Medical plans to showcase its CES Innovation Award-winning smart thermometer and seek partnerships to expand its distribution across diverse regions.

The smart thermometer features an integrated endoscopic camera for at-home otitis media detection, improving early diagnosis rates to over 90%. This helps mitigate complications associated with otitis media and other ENT (ear, nose, throat) conditions.

body.cap: | Dr. In Home mobile application | Photo by Otiton-Medical

body.x: The thermometer is equipped with a high-precision sensor that limits error margins to ±0.1°C, ensuring reliable temperature readings. It also connects to the Dr. In-Home mobile application, so users and caregivers can access health data anytime, anywhere. The platform supports multiple users, making it an ideal family healthcare solution.

Otiton-Medical’s representative stated, “Through the Dr. In Home brand, we offer caregivers a tool to monitor and manage children’s health conditions, empowering families with accessible healthcare solutions. This approach led to the recognition of the CES Innovation Award, highlighting our impact on the home healthcare sector.”

The company also revealed its plans to make 2025 a pivotal year for growth. “CES 2025 presents an excellent opportunity to expand our network globally. By delivering professional-grade diagnostic solutions for the home, we aim to establish Dr. In Home as a trusted brand in international markets,” the representative added.

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
